name: REPRTEST.jcl
description:
This JCL job performs a backup of the CardDemo transaction VSAM file by using the IDCAMS REPRO utility to copy all transaction records from the active VSAM KSDS file into a new sequential backup Generation Data Group (GDG) dataset. The job creates a new generation of the backup file each time it runs, preserving historical copies of the transaction data.Key Functionalities:
Reads all transaction records from the active CardDemo transaction VSAM KSDS file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) as the source input.
Creates a new generation backup copy (+1) of the transaction data in a sequential GDG dataset (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP) with fixed-length records of 350 bytes per record.
The newly created backup dataset is cataloged and allocated on disk with an initial space of 1 cylinder with 1 cylinder extension, and unused space is released upon job completion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The live Card Demo Transaction VSAM master file (FILEIN: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) is available and accessible
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The REPRO utility is executed with INFILE pointing to the live transaction file and OUTFILE pointing to the backup destination
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Every card transaction record from the live transaction master file is copied in full to the backup file — no records are skipped, filtered, or partially extracted

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS - Full Copy of All Card Transaction Records
rules.Rule_Description: All card transaction records from the live transaction master file must be completely copied to the backup file without any filtering, selection, or exclusion criteria.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The live Card Demo Transaction VSAM master file may be actively accessed by other business processes or users
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backup process begins reading records from the live transaction file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction file is accessed in shared mode, allowing all other concurrent processes to continue reading from or writing to the live transaction file without any interruption or lock-out

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS - Non-Disruptive Shared Access to Live Transaction File
rules.Rule_Description: The backup process must not block or interrupt other business processes that are concurrently accessing the live Card Demo Transaction file during the backup window.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Demo Transaction Backup Generation Data Group (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.BKUP) exists in the system catalog
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backup copy process is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A brand new generation (+1) of the backup file is created as the next sequential version, and all previously created backup generations remain intact and accessible for historical reference or recovery

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS - New Versioned Backup Generation Creation
rules.Rule_Description: Each execution of the backup job must produce a new, uniquely versioned snapshot of the Card Demo Transaction data, while all prior backup generations are preserved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new backup generation has been created and the REPRO copy process is running
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The REPRO utility completes all record copying without any errors
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The new backup generation is permanently cataloged in the system, making it available and retrievable for any future card transaction data recovery, audit, or reference needs

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS - Backup Cataloged Upon Successful Completion
rules.Rule_Description: A successfully completed backup generation must be permanently cataloged and made available for business recovery or audit use.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new backup generation has been initiated and the REPRO copy process is running
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The REPRO utility encounters an error or fails to complete successfully
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The incomplete backup generation is automatically deleted from the system entirely, ensuring that no partial, corrupt, or unreliable backup data is ever retained, cataloged, or made available for recovery use

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS - Incomplete Backup Automatically Deleted on Failure
rules.Rule_Description: If the backup process fails for any reason, the incomplete or partial backup generation must be automatically discarded to prevent corrupt or unreliable data from being retained.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Card transaction records are being written to the new backup generation file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backup file is created and records are stored
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Every record in the backup file is stored at a fixed length of exactly 350 characters in fixed-block format, ensuring that the backup data is structurally consistent and reliable for any downstream recovery or audit process

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS - Fixed Record Length Enforcement for Backup File
rules.Rule_Description: All card transaction records written to the backup file must conform to a fixed record length of 350 characters to ensure structural consistency and data integrity of the backup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The backup file has been written with all card transaction records and the copy process has completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The backup job finishes writing data to the new backup generation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Any pre-allocated disk space that was not consumed by the backup data is automatically released back to the system, ensuring efficient and optimized use of storage resources without requiring manual intervention

rules.Rule_Name: PRC001 - IDCAMS - Automatic Release of Unused Backup Storage Space
rules.Rule_Description: After the backup data has been written, any pre-allocated disk space that was not used must be automatically released back to the system to optimize storage utilization.
